recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work on blood typing example codes, profiles, or common guidance should proceed under later resolved work-group decisions rather than under this already-applied R5 technical correction.
issue_request: FHIR-37510 was a Published/Persuasive OO technical correction for the R5 Observation example at observation-example-rhstatus, reporting that the example named rhstatus was actually for ABO blood group and should have its Rh/ABO content corrected.
initial_application: The issue was applied in HL7/fhir PR 2480 by commit 774969bc72034d21d89c40d97c10c29cf69573f1, merged as f725ab4ce948912647c994fa5902d4f4549357f2. That patch changed observation-example-rhstatus.xml from ABO group code/value content to Rh group/Rh-positive content.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the source/observation examples are in build scope. Current source keeps ABO blood group in the separate observation-example-bloodgroup.xml and lists bloodgroup and rhstatus distinctly. Later blood-type issues raise broader profile/guidance and code-quality questions, but FHIR-28455 resolved Not Persuasive/No Change and FHIR-50918 remains Triaged/Unresolved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current rhstatus example has Rh-specific LOINC/SNOMED content, while the paired bloodgroup example has the ABO content, so applying another correction for this seed would be redundant or risk reintroducing the mismatch.

Later guidance request mentioning bloodgroup/rhstatus examples; it is Triaged/Unresolved and not a final source-edit decision.
